_readme: A line here overrides what scripts/build_context_map.mjs reads out of the file, and is the only description for a file that documents itself nowhere — the house style keeps source comment-free. The script warns about a file left with neither, and about an entry whose file is gone. Keys are repo-relative paths.
src/App.tsx: The route table: providers, the shell route, and `/:sectionId/:leafId` under it.
src/main.tsx: Mounts `App` into `#root`. Nothing else lives here.
src/index.css: Tailwind v4 entry and every shadcn design token, light and dark. The only stylesheet.
src/lib/utils.ts: `cn()` — the Tailwind class merger every component imports.
src/hooks/use-mobile.ts: Viewport width as a boolean, for the sidebar's drawer/rail switch. shadcn-generated name, hence the dash.
src/config/nav_items.ts: The sidebar tree, and the source of every route: `/{section.id}/{leaf.id}`.
src/pages/dashboard_page.tsx: Route `/` — coverage stat tiles, the gaps card and the jump-in shortcuts.
src/components/layout/app_header.tsx: Top bar: sidebar trigger, breadcrumb, language picker, theme toggle.
src/components/layout/app_sidebar.tsx: The nav tree from `config/nav_items.ts`, with its outstanding-count badges.
src/components/dashboard/stat_tile.tsx: One headline number with a label and hint; skeletons while it loads.
src/components/translations/group_filter: Searchable group combobox; `ALL_GROUPS` is its unset sentinel.
src/lib/motion.ts: The app’s one motion vocabulary: the durations, eases and variants every animated component uses.
